firstLines: Rachel Nguyen
Portland, OR | (503) 555-0175 | rachel.nguyen@email.com | linkedin.com/in/rachelnguyen
SUMMARY
Elementary teacher with seven years in second and third grade and an Oregon Professional Teaching License
with Elementary–Multiple Subjects and ESOL endorsements. Known for small-group reading work and steady
communication with families.
EXPERIENCE
Third Grade Teacher Aug 2022 – Present
Thimbleberry Elementary School Portland, OR
• Teach 26 students, nine of them English learners; the share reading at grade level rose from 58% to 77% in
one year
• Run daily small-group reading blocks using running records to regroup students every three weeks
• Send a short weekly update to families in English and Spanish and hold conferences twice a year with 100%
attendance
• Mentor two student teachers from Filbert Hill University each spring
Second Grade Teacher Aug 2019 – Jun 2022
Mossbrook Elementary School Salem, OR
• Moved the class to Google Classroom in two weeks during remote learning and kept daily attendance above
• Built a math station rotation that the grade-level team used across all four second grade classes
• Served on the school's behavior support team and helped write the first schoolwide reward system
• Coached the after-school running club for 40 students in grades 2 to 5
EDUCATION
Filbert Hill University Salem, OR
Master of Arts in Teaching, Elementary Education Jun 2019
• Student teaching: second grade, Mossbrook Elementary School
CERTIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
License: Oregon Professional Teaching License; Elementary–Multiple Subjects and ESOL endorsements
Classroom: Guided reading, running records, IEPs, 504 plans
Tools: Google Classroom, Seesaw, Lexia, i-Ready
